_comment: Titre et sous-titre de chaque schéma. Séparés du code parce qu'ils relèvent de la rédaction, pas du dessin — et parce qu'un rendu qui invente son propre titre quand il en manque un finit par publier une figure sans légende. tools/render-schematics.js échoue si une entrée manque.

gap_and_stop.title: A stop cannot fill where no price exists
gap_and_stop.subtitle: The order fires at the level you chose. It then looks for a buyer between that level and the next quoted price — and finds none.

stop_vs_stop_limit.title: Two orders, two different ways to be wrong
stop_vs_stop_limit.subtitle: A stop guarantees an exit but not a price. A stop-limit guarantees a price but not an exit. Choose which failure you can live with.

yield_curve_shapes.title: The three shapes a yield curve takes
yield_curve_shapes.subtitle: Same instrument, different maturities. The shape says what the market expects of the near future relative to the far one.

option_payoff.title: What a bought option can and cannot cost you
option_payoff.subtitle: The premium is the floor of the loss. Everything above the strike is upside; everything below it is the premium, already spent.

fee_drag.title: A fee compounds against you the way returns compound for you
fee_drag.subtitle: The gap between the two paths is not a performance difference. It is arithmetic, and it widens with time.

correlation_breaks.title: Diversification is measured in calm and spent in stress
correlation_breaks.subtitle: Two assets can be uncorrelated on average and fall together on the one day that decides the year.

decision_flow.title: A fact is not a decision, and a decision is not an order
decision_flow.subtitle: Keeping the three objects separate is what makes a process auditable after the fact — and correctable before it.

position_sizing.title: Size decides what a bad night costs you
position_sizing.subtitle: Per-unit risk stays the same. What changes is whether the loss is an inconvenience or an event you cannot recover from.

seasonality_caution.title: A calendar pattern is a hypothesis, not a rule
seasonality_caution.subtitle: A few dozen observations per month is a small sample. Treat the shape as something to test, never as something to trade on its own.

policy_transmission.title: How a rate decision reaches an asset price
policy_transmission.subtitle: The decision moves the near end of the curve. The far end moves on what the decision implies about everything after it.

journal_loop.title: Without the record, the loop is just repetition
journal_loop.subtitle: A trading journal is not a diary. It is the only instrument that turns a series of decisions into something you can measure.

high_beta.title: Amplification is symmetric
high_beta.subtitle: A high-beta proxy magnifies the move in both directions. That is not an edge — it is a reason to size differently.

calendar_certainty.title: Not all dates are known equally far in advance
calendar_certainty.subtitle: What an authority publishes a year ahead belongs in a reference you keep. What nobody schedules is what your position size must survive.
